source.title: Pearson PTE - Updates to PTE Academic (7 August 2025)

format_note.id: PTE Academic sejak 7 Agustus 2025: 22 jenis soal (tambahan Summarize Group Discussion & Respond to a Situation), durasi sekitar 2 jam, sebagian jawaban dinilai AI + manusia.
format_note.en: PTE Academic since 7 August 2025: 22 question types (new: Summarize Group Discussion & Respond to a Situation), about 2 hours, some answers scored by AI + human raters.
format_note.th: PTE Academic ตั้งแต่ 7 ส.ค. 2025: 22 ประเภทข้อสอบ (ใหม่: Summarize Group Discussion และ Respond to a Situation) ประมาณ 2 ชั่วโมง บางคำตอบให้คะแนนโดย AI + ผู้ตรวจ
format_note.vi: PTE Academic từ 7/8/2025: 22 dạng câu hỏi (mới: Summarize Group Discussion & Respond to a Situation), khoảng 2 giờ, một số câu được AI + giám khảo chấm.
format_note.zh: 自 2025 年 8 月 7 日起 PTE Academic：22 种题型（新增 Summarize Group Discussion 和 Respond to a Situation），约 2 小时，部分答案由 AI + 人工评分。
format_note.ja: 2025年8月7日以降の PTE Academic：22種類の問題（新：Summarize Group Discussion、Respond to a Situation）、約2時間、一部はAI＋人が採点。
format_note.ko: 2025년 8월 7일 이후 PTE Academic: 22개 문제 유형(신규: Summarize Group Discussion, Respond to a Situation), 약 2시간, 일부 답안은 AI + 사람 채점.
format_note.km: PTE Academic ចាប់ពី 7 សីហា 2025៖ ប្រភេទសំណួរ 22 (ថ្មី៖ Summarize Group Discussion និង Respond to a Situation) ប្រហែល 2 ម៉ោង ចម្លើយខ្លះដាក់ពិន្ទុដោយ AI + មនុស្ស។
format_note.fr: PTE Academic depuis le 7 août 2025 : 22 types de questions (nouveaux : Summarize Group Discussion et Respond to a Situation), environ 2 h, certaines réponses notées par IA + correcteurs humains.
format_note.pt: PTE Academic desde 7/8/2025: 22 tipos de questão (novas: Summarize Group Discussion e Respond to a Situation), cerca de 2 horas, algumas respostas avaliadas por IA + avaliadores humanos.
format_note.es: PTE Academic desde el 7/8/2025: 22 tipos de pregunta (nuevas: Summarize Group Discussion y Respond to a Situation), unas 2 horas, algunas respuestas calificadas por IA + evaluadores humanos.
format_note.de: PTE Academic seit 7.8.2025: 22 Aufgabentypen (neu: Summarize Group Discussion und Respond to a Situation), ca. 2 Stunden, einige Antworten von KI + Menschen bewertet.
format_note.it: PTE Academic dal 7/8/2025: 22 tipi di domanda (nuovi: Summarize Group Discussion e Respond to a Situation), circa 2 ore, alcune risposte valutate da IA + valutatori umani.
format_note.nl: PTE Academic sinds 7-8-2025: 22 vraagtypes (nieuw: Summarize Group Discussion en Respond to a Situation), ongeveer 2 uur, sommige antwoorden door AI + mensen beoordeeld.
format_note.ru: PTE Academic с 7.08.2025: 22 типа заданий (новые: Summarize Group Discussion и Respond to a Situation), около 2 часов, часть ответов оценивают ИИ и люди.

items.template:
• Read the text silently first (about 30-40 seconds of preparation).
• Speak at a steady, natural pace — do not rush.
• Pause briefly at commas and full stops.
• If you make a mistake, keep going; do not go back and correct it.

hint.id: Baca tenang dan lancar; jangan berhenti untuk mengulang kata yang salah.
hint.en: Read calmly and smoothly; do not stop to repeat a wrong word.
hint.th: อ่านอย่างใจเย็นและลื่นไหล อย่าหยุดเพื่อพูดคำที่ผิดซ้ำ
hint.vi: Đọc bình tĩnh, trôi chảy; đừng dừng lại để đọc lại từ sai.
hint.zh: 平稳流畅地朗读；读错时不要停下来重读。
hint.ja: 落ち着いてなめらかに読みましょう。間違えても言い直さないこと。
hint.ko: 차분하고 매끄럽게 읽으세요. 틀린 단어를 다시 말하려고 멈추지 마세요.
hint.km: អានដោយស្ងប់ និងរលូន កុំឈប់ដើម្បីអានពាក្យខុសម្តងទៀត។
hint.fr: Lisez calmement et de façon fluide ; ne vous arrêtez pas pour corriger un mot.
hint.pt: Leia com calma e fluidez; não pare para repetir uma palavra errada.
hint.es: Lee con calma y fluidez; no te detengas a repetir una palabra equivocada.
hint.de: Ruhig und flüssig lesen; nicht anhalten, um ein falsches Wort zu wiederholen.
hint.it: Leggi con calma e scorrevolezza; non fermarti a ripetere una parola sbagliata.
hint.nl: Lees rustig en vloeiend; stop niet om een fout woord te herhalen.
hint.ru: Читайте спокойно и плавно; не останавливайтесь, чтобы повторить ошибку.

items.template:
The [chart / graph / diagram / map] shows [topic].
The highest [category] is [X], at [value], while the lowest is [Y], at [value].
Another key point is that [one more real detail from the image].
Overall, [the main trend or comparison].
In conclusion, the image suggests that [one-sentence takeaway].

hint.id: Isi dengan 2-3 angka/detail nyata dari gambar; jangan hanya mengucapkan kerangka.
hint.en: Fill in 2-3 real numbers/details from the image; do not just say the frame.
hint.th: ใส่ตัวเลข/รายละเอียดจริงจากภาพ 2-3 จุด อย่าพูดแค่โครง
hint.vi: Điền 2-3 số liệu/chi tiết thật từ hình; đừng chỉ đọc khung mẫu.
hint.zh: 填入图中 2-3 个真实数据或细节；不要只说模板。
hint.ja: 画像の実際の数値・詳細を 2-3 個入れること。枠だけ話さない。
hint.ko: 이미지의 실제 수치·세부 사항 2-3개를 넣으세요. 틀만 말하지 마세요.
hint.km: បំពេញលេខ/ព័ត៌មានពិត 2-3 ពីរូបភាព កុំនិយាយតែគំរូ។
hint.fr: Ajoutez 2-3 chiffres/détails réels de l’image ; ne récitez pas seulement le cadre.
hint.pt: Inclua 2-3 números/detalhes reais da imagem; não diga só o modelo.
hint.es: Incluye 2-3 cifras/detalles reales de la imagen; no digas solo la plantilla.
hint.de: 2-3 echte Zahlen/Details aus dem Bild einsetzen; nicht nur das Gerüst sprechen.
hint.it: Inserisci 2-3 numeri/dettagli reali dell’immagine; non dire solo lo schema.
hint.nl: Vul 2-3 echte cijfers/details uit de afbeelding in; zeg niet alleen het sjabloon.
hint.ru: Добавьте 2-3 реальных числа/детали с картинки; не произносите только шаблон.

items.template:
The speaker talked about [topic].
First, they explained that [key point 1].
They also mentioned [key point 2] and [key point 3].
In conclusion, the speaker emphasised that [main message].

hint.id: Catat 4-5 kata kunci saat mendengar, lalu masukkan ke kerangka.
hint.en: Note 4-5 keywords while listening, then put them into the frame.
hint.th: จดคำสำคัญ 4-5 คำระหว่างฟัง แล้วใส่ลงในโครง
hint.vi: Ghi 4-5 từ khóa khi nghe rồi đưa vào khung.
hint.zh: 听的时候记下 4-5 个关键词，再放进模板。
hint.ja: 聞きながらキーワードを 4-5 個メモし、枠に入れる。
hint.km: កត់ពាក្យគន្លឹះ 4-5 ពេលស្តាប់ រួចដាក់ក្នុងគំរូ។
hint.fr: Notez 4-5 mots-clés en écoutant, puis placez-les dans le cadre.
hint.pt: Anote 4-5 palavras-chave ao ouvir e coloque-as no modelo.
hint.es: Anota 4-5 palabras clave al escuchar y colócalas en la plantilla.
hint.de: Beim Zuhören 4-5 Schlüsselwörter notieren und ins Gerüst einsetzen.
hint.it: Annota 4-5 parole chiave mentre ascolti e inseriscile nello schema.
hint.nl: Noteer 4-5 sleutelwoorden tijdens het luisteren en zet ze in het sjabloon.
hint.ru: Запишите 4-5 ключевых слов при прослушивании и вставьте их в шаблон.

items.template:
The group discussed [topic].
The first speaker said that [view 1], because [reason].
The second speaker argued that [view 2].
The third speaker added that [view 3].
Overall, the group [agreed / disagreed] that [conclusion].

hint.id: Tugas baru sejak 7 Agustus 2025: sebutkan pendapat tiap pembicara dan kesimpulannya.
hint.en: New task since 7 August 2025: give each speaker’s view and the conclusion.
hint.th: งานใหม่ตั้งแต่ 7 ส.ค. 2025: สรุปความเห็นของผู้พูดแต่ละคนและข้อสรุป
hint.vi: Dạng bài mới từ 7/8/2025: nêu quan điểm từng người và kết luận.
hint.zh: 2025 年 8 月 7 日起的新题型：概括每位发言者的观点和结论。
hint.ja: 2025年8月7日からの新問題：各話者の意見と結論をまとめる。
hint.ko: 2025년 8월 7일부터 새 유형: 각 화자의 의견과 결론을 말하세요.
hint.km: កិច្ចការថ្មីចាប់ពី 7 សីហា 2025៖ ប្រាប់មតិអ្នកនិយាយម្នាក់ៗ និងសេចក្តីសន្និដ្ឋាន។
hint.fr: Nouvelle tâche depuis le 7 août 2025 : donnez l’avis de chaque intervenant et la conclusion.
hint.pt: Nova tarefa desde 7/8/2025: diga a opinião de cada falante e a conclusão.
hint.es: Tarea nueva desde el 7/8/2025: indica la opinión de cada hablante y la conclusión.
hint.de: Neue Aufgabe seit 7.8.2025: Meinung jeder Person und das Fazit nennen.
hint.it: Nuovo compito dal 7/8/2025: riporta l’opinione di ogni parlante e la conclusione.
hint.nl: Nieuwe taak sinds 7-8-2025: geef de mening van elke spreker en de conclusie.
hint.ru: Новое задание с 7.08.2025: изложите мнение каждого участника и вывод.

items.template:
Hi [name], [thank you for… / I’m sorry to hear that…].
I understand that [the situation].
Could we [your main suggestion]?
Alternatively, [a second option].
Please let me know what works best for you. Thank you.

hint.id: Tugas baru: jawab sopan seperti bicara langsung ke orangnya, beri solusi yang jelas.
hint.en: New task: reply politely as if speaking to the person, and give a clear solution.
hint.th: งานใหม่: ตอบอย่างสุภาพเหมือนคุยกับบุคคลนั้น และเสนอทางออกที่ชัดเจน
hint.vi: Dạng bài mới: trả lời lịch sự như đang nói với người đó, đưa giải pháp rõ ràng.
hint.zh: 新题型：像直接对那个人说话一样礼貌回应，并给出明确方案。
hint.ja: 新問題：相手に直接話すように丁寧に答え、明確な解決策を示す。
hint.ko: 새 유형: 그 사람에게 직접 말하듯 정중하게 답하고 명확한 해결책을 제시하세요.
hint.km: កិច្ចការថ្មី៖ ឆ្លើយដោយគួរសម ដូចនិយាយផ្ទាល់ទៅអ្នកនោះ ហើយផ្តល់ដំណោះស្រាយច្បាស់។
hint.fr: Nouvelle tâche : répondez poliment comme si vous parliez à la personne et proposez une solution claire.
hint.pt: Nova tarefa: responda com educação como se falasse com a pessoa e dê uma solução clara.
hint.es: Tarea nueva: responde con cortesía como si hablaras con la persona y da una solución clara.
hint.de: Neue Aufgabe: höflich antworten, als sprächest du mit der Person, und eine klare Lösung nennen.
hint.it: Nuovo compito: rispondi con cortesia come se parlassi alla persona e proponi una soluzione chiara.
hint.nl: Nieuwe taak: antwoord beleefd alsof je tegen die persoon praat en geef een duidelijke oplossing.
hint.ru: Новое задание: вежливо ответьте, как будто говорите с человеком, и предложите чёткое решение.

items.template:
• Answer with one word or a few words only (e.g. “a thermometer”).
• Do not repeat the question or add a full sentence.
• If unsure, give your best single-word guess — silence scores zero.

hint.id: Jawab 1-3 kata saja, langsung ke inti.
hint.en: Answer in 1-3 words only, straight to the point.
hint.th: ตอบเพียง 1-3 คำ ตรงประเด็น
hint.vi: Chỉ trả lời 1-3 từ, đi thẳng vào ý.
hint.zh: 只用 1-3 个词直接回答。
hint.km: ឆ្លើយតែ 1-3 ពាក្យ ចំចំណុច។
hint.pt: Responda com 1-3 palavras, direto ao ponto.
hint.de: Nur mit 1-3 Wörtern antworten, direkt auf den Punkt.
hint.it: Rispondi solo con 1-3 parole, dritto al punto.

items.template: The passage explains that [main idea], which [key detail 1], and although [contrasting point], [key detail 2].

hint.id: Tepat SATU kalimat (5-75 kata), satu titik di akhir; pakai kata penghubung.
hint.en: Exactly ONE sentence (5-75 words), one full stop at the end; use linking words.
hint.th: หนึ่งประโยคเท่านั้น (5-75 คำ) มีจุดเดียวที่ท้าย ใช้คำเชื่อม
hint.vi: Đúng MỘT câu (5-75 từ), một dấu chấm cuối; dùng từ nối.
hint.zh: 只写一句话（5-75 词），结尾一个句号；使用连接词。
hint.ja: 1文のみ（5-75語）、最後にピリオド1つ。接続語を使う。
hint.ko: 정확히 한 문장(5-75단어), 끝에 마침표 하나. 연결어를 쓰세요.
hint.km: មួយប្រយោគប៉ុណ្ណោះ (5-75 ពាក្យ) មានចុចមួយនៅចុង ប្រើពាក្យភ្ជាប់។
hint.fr: UNE seule phrase (5-75 mots), un seul point final ; utilisez des connecteurs.
hint.pt: Apenas UMA frase (5-75 palavras), um ponto final; use conectivos.
hint.es: Solo UNA oración (5-75 palabras), un punto final; usa conectores.
hint.de: Genau EIN Satz (5-75 Wörter), ein Punkt am Ende; Bindewörter nutzen.
hint.it: Una SOLA frase (5-75 parole), un punto finale; usa connettivi.
hint.nl: Precies ÉÉN zin (5-75 woorden), één punt aan het eind; gebruik verbindingswoorden.
hint.ru: Ровно ОДНО предложение (5-75 слов), одна точка в конце; используйте связки.

items.template:
Introduction: In recent years, [topic] has become an important issue. While some people believe [view A], others argue [view B]. In my opinion, [your position], for the reasons outlined below.

Body 1: Firstly, [reason 1]. For example, [specific example]. As a result, [effect].

Body 2: Secondly, [reason 2]. This is because [explanation]. For instance, [example].

Conclusion: In conclusion, although [opposing view], I believe [your position] because [summary of reasons 1 and 2].

hint.id: 200-300 kata; jawab pertanyaan soal secara langsung dengan contoh sendiri.
hint.en: 200-300 words; answer the prompt directly with your own examples.
hint.th: 200-300 คำ ตอบโจทย์โดยตรงพร้อมตัวอย่างของตัวเอง
hint.vi: 200-300 từ; trả lời trực tiếp đề bài với ví dụ của riêng bạn.
hint.zh: 200-300 词；直接回应题目，并使用自己的例子。
hint.ja: 200-300語。設問に直接答え、自分の例を使う。
hint.ko: 200-300단어. 문제에 직접 답하고 자신의 예를 드세요.
hint.km: 200-300 ពាក្យ ឆ្លើយសំណួរដោយផ្ទាល់ ជាមួយឧទាហរណ៍ផ្ទាល់ខ្លួន។
hint.fr: 200-300 mots ; répondez directement au sujet avec vos propres exemples.
hint.pt: 200-300 palavras; responda ao tema diretamente com exemplos próprios.
hint.es: 200-300 palabras; responde al tema directamente con ejemplos propios.
hint.de: 200-300 Wörter; direkt auf die Aufgabe eingehen, mit eigenen Beispielen.
hint.it: 200-300 parole; rispondi direttamente alla traccia con esempi tuoi.
hint.nl: 200-300 woorden; beantwoord de opdracht direct met eigen voorbeelden.
hint.ru: 200-300 слов; отвечайте прямо на тему, со своими примерами.

items.template: The speaker discussed [topic]. According to the speaker, [key point 1]. Furthermore, [key point 2]. The speaker also mentioned that [key point 3]. In conclusion, [main message].

hint.id: 50-70 kata; tulis kata kunci saat audio diputar, periksa ejaan di akhir.
hint.en: 50-70 words; write keywords while the audio plays, check spelling at the end.
hint.th: 50-70 คำ จดคำสำคัญขณะฟัง ตรวจการสะกดตอนท้าย
hint.vi: 50-70 từ; ghi từ khóa khi nghe, kiểm tra chính tả cuối cùng.
hint.zh: 50-70 词；播放时记关键词，最后检查拼写。
hint.ja: 50-70語。音声中にキーワードをメモし、最後にスペルを確認。
hint.ko: 50-70단어. 들으면서 키워드를 적고 마지막에 철자를 확인하세요.
hint.km: 50-70 ពាក្យ កត់ពាក្យគន្លឹះពេលស្តាប់ ពិនិត្យអក្ខរាវិរុទ្ធនៅចុង។
hint.fr: 50-70 mots ; notez les mots-clés pendant l’audio, vérifiez l’orthographe à la fin.
hint.pt: 50-70 palavras; anote palavras-chave durante o áudio e revise a ortografia.
hint.es: 50-70 palabras; anota palabras clave durante el audio y revisa la ortografía.
hint.de: 50-70 Wörter; beim Hören Schlüsselwörter notieren, am Ende Rechtschreibung prüfen.
hint.it: 50-70 parole; annota parole chiave durante l’audio e controlla l’ortografia.
hint.nl: 50-70 woorden; noteer sleutelwoorden tijdens het luisteren, controleer spelling.
hint.ru: 50-70 слов; записывайте ключевые слова во время аудио, проверьте орфографию.
